limitations: QA source-material candidate only: not approval, legal assurance, native qualification, or attestation of a generator command execution.

Raw reports do not embed selected-target provenance, resolved feature activation, invocation or configuration digests; adjacent about logs are empty. Target membership here comes from the six named report files.
Cargo.lock registry archive checksums are recorded; existing local source files were read and hashed. Registry archives were not downloaded or rehashed in this review.
A coalesced generator group representative path is not per-used_by provenance; every original non-null binding has a separately byte-matched package legal file.
Canonical MIT/MPL generator hashes remain distinct from mapped actual files; both Windows mappings intentionally differ from the canonical generator text.
Windows linked native-runtime materials remain outside this candidate. Rust precompiled-standard-library materials have a separate retained-material review and are not among these crate bindings.
